reviewMethod: Every listed frame was opened and inspected individually and sequentially at its native 1280x960 capture size. Contact sheets, thumbnails, and image metrics were not substituted for visual review.

story.finding: All 36 schema-4 captures were opened individually in level order after passing requested-geometry ordering, native live-3D readback, a positive level-loop or gameplay-HUD gate, and explicit GAME OVER plus SAVE GAME PROGRESS exclusions. They preserve the PS1 environments and exercise all 34 story-loaded Dreamcast actor overrides. L8A6 uses its verified earlier real-time chase window at frames 2400 and 2450 because its old 4300/4400 window had already reached the save menu. L7A5 frame 4300 is partly boss-occluded, so story-route validity and resource coverage are not treated as substitute visual acceptance for any model or user-held actor.

viewer.finding: All 26 fresh schema-3 captures were opened and inspected individually in roster order after each was anchored to its exact model load and passed the native live-3D 16bpp plus CHARACTER VIEWER screen gate. The user accepted the current Black Cat, neutral-grey Jameson, and articulated Scorpion proofs on 2026-09-01. MYSTVIEW intentionally has no fishbowl mesh: both original Dreamcast MYSTVIEW.PSX and MYSTERIO.PSX decode without one, so the bowl is a separate retail effect rather than lost converted geometry.

hostagef.finding: Both fresh schema-3 captures were inspected individually after their exact model loads passed the native live-3D 16bpp and CHARACTER VIEWER gates. The target frame shows the complete HOSTAGEF kneeling/surrender pose with intact head, limbs, and light-colored clothing in the Parker viewer slot.

symbiote.finding: All 19 fresh schema-3 captures were inspected individually in exact roster order after their model-load-anchored native live-3D 16bpp and CHARACTER VIEWER gates passed. The final target frame confirms that the otherwise unrouted SYMBIOTE alias is the complete authored translucent magenta goo form used by the compatible SYMBI_02 slot.

jamesonScorpion.finding: All 11 fresh schema-4 frames passed the positive gameplay gate and explicit GAME OVER plus SAVE GAME PROGRESS exclusions, then were inspected individually in sequence. Scorpion's blue/green tail remains connected and continuously articulated through its curl, sweep, and extension. Jameson's body is partially visible at the far right in frames 4275 through 4325 with a stable gray/blue shirt, red tie, and beige trousers rather than the earlier technicolor corruption; his clearest full-body evidence remains the neutral-gray schema-3 Character Viewer capture. The user accepted both actors' current proofs on 2026-09-01.
